summary: Netlist filed an 8-K disclosing an October 5, 2026 settlement and release with Micron resolving all identified pending litigation, paired with a five-year worldwide non-exclusive patent license covering Netlist's entire portfolio at $30 million quarterly for twenty quarters ($600 million total, Q4 2026–Q3 2031). Micron separately bought 10 million unregistered shares for $1 million aggregate ($0.10/share) under Section 4(a)(2), with 20% released from lock-up annually through year four and the remainder at year five. Closing expected by October 6, 2026. Watch collection risk on license payments and Micron's overhang.
